title: Image Combiner
subtitle: BA PvP Result Combiner
quality_png_help: Quality is unused because PNG is lossless
crop_auto_help: Automatically detects the background to crop
crop_auto_coords_help: Filled automatically during processing in Auto Mode
mask_description: Fills the specified area on the right (opponent) to hide it
mask_mode_ratio_help: Specified as percentages (0–100%) of the cropped area
ratio_preview_empty: Select images to preview the masked area
ratio_preview_autocrop_fallback: Could not auto-detect crop bounds; showing the full image instead
ratio_preview_error: Failed to load the preview image
mask_mode_manual_help: Specified in pixel coordinates from the top-left of the original image
mask_mode_ocr_help: Detects "Lv." automatically and fills the coordinates below (read-only)
self_mask_description: Fills the specified area on the left (your side) to hide it
reset_settings_confirm_message: All layout, cropping, and masking settings will be restored to their defaults. Selected images, theme, and language will be kept.
upload_intro: Combines BA PvP result images into one
drop_images_here: Drop PNG or JPEG images here to add
drop_zone_hint: Also supports dragging & dropping PNG / JPEG images
preview_image_load_failed: Failed to load the image preview. The file may be corrupted.
result_stale_settings: Settings have changed. Reprocess to apply the latest settings.
result_stale_images: Selected images have changed. Reprocess to update the result.
result_stale_both: Settings and selected images have changed. Reprocess to update the result.
alert_share_failed: Failed to share the image. Try saving it instead.
alert_no_supported_images: No supported images (PNG / JPEG) were found.
alert_columns_must_be_positive: Columns must be a positive number.
alert_offset_cannot_be_empty_or_negative: Offset (px) must be an integer between 0 and 50.
alert_invalid_crop_setting: Crop settings are invalid. X and Y must be 0 or greater, and Width and Height must be positive integers.
alert_crop_outside_image: The crop area is outside the image ({{width}} × {{height}} px). Adjust the crop settings.
alert_invalid_mask_area: The mask (or self-mask) area must have a width and height greater than 0.
alert_mask_outside_crop: The manual mask (or self-mask) area is outside the crop area. Adjust the mask coordinates (relative to the full image) or crop settings.
alert_mask_outside_image: The mask (or self-mask) area only covers the padding outside the image ({{width}} × {{height}} px). Adjust the mask or crop settings.
alert_invalid_color_setting: Color settings must be valid opaque hex colors (e.g., #000000).
alert_failed_to_get_temp_canvas_context_: Failed to get temporary canvas context for auto-crop.
alert_failed_to_detect_crop_area: Failed to detect crop area automatically. Please set it manually.
alert_could_not_find_right_lv: Could not find 'Lv.' text on the right side. Adjust the image or crop and retry, or switch to Manual/Ratio mode.
alert_could_not_find_left_lv: Could not find 'Lv.' text on the left side. Adjust the image or crop and retry, or switch to Manual/Ratio mode.
alert_ocr_error: An error occurred during OCR processing. Retry, or switch to Manual/Ratio mode.
alert_image_generation_failed: Failed to generate the final image, possibly due to memory limitations. Please try again with fewer images.
alert_image_decode_failed: Failed to decode "{{fileName}}". Please check the file or remove it from the list and try again.
alert_image_resolution_mismatch: Resolution of "{{fileName}}" ({{actualWidth}} × {{actualHeight}} px) does not match the first image ({{expectedWidth}} × {{expectedHeight}} px). Please select only images with the same resolution and try again.
alert_processing_failed: There might not be enough memory. Please try again.
alert_canvas_not_ready: Canvas is not ready. Please try again.
alert_failed_to_get_context: Failed to get 2D rendering context from canvas. Please try again.
alert_invalid_canvas_size: Calculated output canvas size is invalid ({{width}} × {{height}} px). Please check your settings.
confirm_large_canvas_size:
The output image is very large ({{width}} × {{height}} px / {{pixels}} pixels).
Generation or display may fail depending on your browser or device memory limits. Do you want to continue?
alert_webp_canvas_size:
The output size ({{width}} × {{height}} px) exceeds the WebP format limit of {{maxWebpDimension}} px.
WebP cannot export images beyond this limit without silent truncation. Switch the Output Format to PNG or JPEG, or adjust the column count / number of images and try again.
alert_output_dimension_mismatch:
The encoded image size ({{actualWidth}} × {{actualHeight}} px) does not match the expected size ({{expectedWidth}} × {{expectedHeight}} px).
The output may have been truncated due to format or browser size limits. Switch the Output Format (PNG / JPEG) or adjust the column count / number of images and try again.
status_waiting_cancelled_encode: Waiting for the cancelled processing to stop...
alert_cancelled_encode_slow: The cancelled processing is taking a long time to stop. If it does not stop, reload the page (you will need to select the images again).
